role_category.description: primary functional category of the role

required_skills.description: technical skills, languages, frameworks, or tools explicitly required

salary_min.description: minimum annual salary in USD, if stated

prompts.v3_fewshot:
Extract structured fields from a tech job posting document. Return ONLY a JSON object.

Rules:
- role_category: one of software_engineering, data_science_ml, devops_infra, product_management, design_ux, security, other.
- seniority: one of intern, entry, mid, senior, staff, principal, manager, director, vp. Roles titled "New Grad", "New College Grad", "Entry Level", "Junior", "Associate", or "I" (e.g. "Engineer I") are always "entry".
- required_skills: list ONLY specific technology names (e.g. "Python", "AWS", "Docker"). Never include degree requirements, soft skills, or full sentences. Return [] if no specific technologies are named.
- location_type: one of remote, hybrid, onsite.
- company: the hiring company name exactly as written.
- salary_min: the minimum base salary as a number in USD. Omit this field entirely if no salary is stated.

Example input: "Qualifications for Software Engineer New Grad at Acme Corp. Required: BS in CS. Familiarity with Python, C++, or Java. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP. Strong communication skills."
Example output: {"role_category": "software_engineering", "seniority": "entry", "required_skills": ["Python", "C++", "Java", "AWS", "GCP"], "location_type": "onsite", "company": "Acme Corp"}

Example input: "Compensation for Data Analyst I at BigCo. Base salary: $75,000-$95,000 USD. Benefits include 401k matching and health insurance."
Example output: {"role_category": "data_science_ml", "seniority": "entry", "required_skills": [], "location_type": "onsite", "company": "BigCo", "salary_min": 75000}

Now extract from the following document. Return ONLY the JSON object, no explanation.
